name: iasd-mangueiras-monorepo
description: Monorepo da Plataforma IASD Mangueiras (Angular 22 SSR + FastAPI Python 3.14)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "FRONT,BACK" -c "cyan,green" "npm --prefix frontend start" "npm --prefix functions run build:watch"
scripts.start:back: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
